payload.title: Every site deploys automatically on merge to main
payload.description:
Ryan's rule (2026-10-21): every site deploys automatically through DevOps when a change merges to main. Manual deploys are acceptable only during development. Infra creation is pre-approved for this epic; never delete resources.

Acceptance for every site below: an empty commit merged to main starts the site's build and deploy with no manual step, and the run finishes green and updates the live site (check with curl: the deployed artefact or an etag/last-modified changes).

Sites that fail the rule today (evidence from 2026-10-21):
- kanb.us (Kanbus-web, account kanbus-production 494166748521): no CI at all. The Amplify app and the kanbus-web-infra pipeline described in infra/README.md were never created. The 2026-10-21 deploy was a local projection pushed with a script (S3PageWriter) plus a CloudFormation change set on kanbus-web-site.
- apricity.anth.us (Apricity-web, stack apricity-marketing-publication in papyrus-production 712236451410): no source-triggered build (no Amplify app or CodeBuild project for the marketing site); published today by running the amplify.yml commands locally. Its develop and main have drifted apart.
- pr.ospect.us (Prospectus-web): the prospectus-marketing pipeline's push trigger did not fire.
- chattic.us (Chattic.us-web, account 340169921348): the Verify stage was broken by a stale buildspec (fixed today, pipeline execution fab36a3c succeeded), but a merge to main (PR #39) still did not start the pipeline; execution 686038ea was started by hand. GitHub Actions CI on this repo also fails before starting jobs (payment/spending-limit message).
- cyclotron.anth.us (Cyclotron-web, account cyclotron-production 682849160744): merge to main (PR #148) did not start the cyclotron-marketing pipeline; execution b2c1ed01 was started by hand.
- aurit.us (Auritus-web, papyrus-production): no Amplify app for it; merging to main publishes nothing. Published today by running scripts/publish_s3.py by hand.

Approved paths: GitHub OIDC role + GitHub Actions publish job, or the planned CodeBuild/CodePipeline per repo. Never delete resources.
